lines: At Uniplus Global Education, we are dedicated to empowering students by providing full-time scholarships to bright individuals. Under the leadership of our director, Muhammed Shabin N, a distinguished Commonwealth Scholar who studied at University College London (UCL), we possess invaluable firsthand experience with prestigious scholarship programs. We are also connected with alumni from renowned scholarships, including the Chevening Scholarship, DAAD Scholarship, Erasmus Mundus Scholarship, Felix Scholarship, Inlaks Scholarship, and many more.

These scholarships typically cover a stipend of approximately ₹130,000 per month for living costs, tuition fees, flight expenses, and assistance with apparel and study materials. From merit-based awards to need-based grants, we are committed to ensuring that financial constraints do not hinder students from achieving their dreams of international education.
Join us at Uniplus Global Education, and let us guide you toward a brighter future!
